components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid oklch(82% 0.1 168); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(82% 0.1 168); color: oklch(22% 0.04 168); font: 500 0.9375rem/1 Figtree, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn:hover { background: oklch(88% 0.07 168); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(86% 0.09 168); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A research record with a feedforward network on the first screen and one frosted window of identity. Inner pages are a flat, hairline notebook. The athletic record is not a visual theme.
keyCharacteristics: One frosted window, on Home only

rules.name: The one signal rule
rules.body: Celadon is the button, the focus color, and the network. It is not a wash behind text.

rules.name: The research-first rule
rules.body: Do not build a hero, a medal wall, or a second accent from the athletic record.

rules.name: The flat notebook rule
rules.body: Inner pages use lightness and hairlines. The home window is the only elevated surface.

dos: Lead with Sharif, then Koç, then learning theory, then applications.
Keep the athletic record to Photos, Story, and one line on About.
donts: Don't add a light theme or a purple-to-blue gradient.
Don't publish a phone number, the PhD offers, or an invented research result.
Don't make table tennis a headline or a home-page element.
